Hope you’re well — I’m Seb from AblySI (Paris). We’re seeing strong demand from a few enterprise customers (financial services + healthcare) who need an inference partner that can offer:

- Data residency in France / EU (customer-controlled storage)

Hi Sébastien — welcome, and thanks for reaching out. We’d love to discuss.

Short answers first:
- Redwood Private supports VPC-hosted control plane + customer-managed data planes; we also offer an on-prem appliance package for air-gapped installs.
- We integrate with customer KMS via standard KMIP / cloud KMS (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK, Azure Key Vault); HSM can be included for MSA customers.
- SOC2 evidence set: we can provide SOC2 Type II report, encryption attestation, and audit-log exports; we typically work with SI partners to map questionnaire items to artifacts.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30–45m):
1) Intros + customer profiles (EU / APAC)
2) Deployment options and constraints (Private vs Dedicated vs on-prem)
3) Security/compliance checklist and evidence handoff
4) Outreach & go-to-market: resale, pricing expectations, and support model
5) Next steps / MAP (mutual action plan)

Availability: I can do Thu May 14 at 09:00 CET / 00:00 PDT, or Fri May 15 at 08:00 CET. Jonas — can you join to cover the technical and PoC details? Marissa — looping you for commercial alignment.

I’ll attach a short solution brief and a partner MoP draft ahead of the call.

Thanks — a few technical clarifications from our side to prep for the kickoff: 

- Expected workload profile: do your customers want synchronous low-latency (<100ms p95) chat/generation, or batch embedding/analytics workloads? This determines whether Dedicated pools or Private on-prem with optimized serving is right.
- Data flow: can customers accept tokenized/hashed prefix caching in the control plane, or must all KV and prefix cache remain entirely inside customer VPC/on-prem?
- Authentication & secrets: for Cloud KMS we support CMEK and cross-account IAM roles; for on-prem we support a PKCS11/HSM integration. Need confirmation on HSM vendor preferences.
- SOC2 / evidence: please send the questionnaire items you commonly receive so we can map artifacts to the Matrix (controls -> evidence -> owner).

I’m attaching the solution brief and a draft partner Map of Procedures (MoP) with recommended PoC acceptance criteria. For PoC acceptance, we usually request:
- Clear performance SLO (latency p95, tokens/sec)
- Quality checks on a small eval set (prompt set + baseline outputs)
- Security checklist signoffs (network, KMS, audit log access)

Attachment: partner-mop-draft.docx

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
